import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:500]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:500])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc
EXPECT={"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}
FRAME=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}]

def chan(name, parts, cases=('a',), events=()):
    return base(cases=[{"name":c,"frames":FRAME,"expect":EXPECT} for c in cases], events=list(events),
                channels=[{"name":name,"parts":[{"case":o,"data":(d.decode('latin-1') if isinstance(d,bytes) else d)} for o,d in parts]}])

def rec(name, parts, cases=('a',)):
    r = run(json.dumps(chan(name, parts, cases)))
    return r['channels'][0], r['cases']

def request(method=b'GET', target=b'/', headers=(), version=b'HTTP/1.1'):
    return method+b' '+target+b' '+version+b'\r\n'+b''.join(n+b':'+v+b'\r\n' for n,v in headers)+b'\r\n'

# framing none, host missing, owner named
c,_ = rec('e',[('a', request())])
check('no framing', (c['error'], c['committed']), (None,[1]))
q=c['requests'][0]
check('no framing offsets', (q['start'],q['end']), (0,len(request())))
check('no framing framing', q['framing'], 'none')
check('no framing body', q['body'], fp(b''))
check('no framing host', (q['host_count'],q['host']), (0,fp(b'')))
check('no framing flags', q['flags'], ['identity','missing_host'])

raw = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost:   Example.COM  \r\nX-A: v\r\nX-B:\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
q=c['requests'][0]
check('trim host', q['host'], fp(b'example.com'))
check('header block fp', q['headers'], fp(field_block([(b'Host',b'Example.COM'),(b'X-A',b'v'),(b'X-B',b'')])))
raw2 = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nX-A:  a  b\tc  \r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw2)])
check('interior bytes', c['requests'][0]['headers'], fp(field_block([(b'X-A',b'a  b\tc')])))
check('host missing count', c['requests'][0]['host_count'], 0)

for value, blen, ok in [(b'5',5,True),(b' 5 ',5,True),(b'0005',5,True),(b'5 , 5',5,True),
                        (b'5,5,5',5,True),(b'0',0,True),(b'',None,False),(b'5,',None,False),
                        (b'5,6',None,False),(b'x',None,False),(b'-1',None,False),(b'+5',None,False),
                        (b'9223372036854775808',None,False)]:
    body = b'ABCDE'
    raw = request(headers=[(b'Content-Length',value)]) + (body[:blen] if ok else b'')
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
    if ok:
        check('cl '+repr(value), (c['requests'][0]['framing'],c['requests'][0]['body'],c['error']), ('length',fp(body[:blen]),None))
    else:
        check('cl bad '+repr(value), c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

raw = request(headers=[(b'Content-Length',b'2'),(b'CONTENT-LENGTH',b' 2 ')]) + b'hi'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('dup cl agree', (c['error'],c['requests'][0]['framing'],c['requests'][0]['body']), (None,'length',fp(b'hi')))
raw = request(headers=[(b'Content-Length',b'2'),(b'Content-Length',b'3')]) + b'hi'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('dup cl conflict', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + b'3\r\nabc\r\n0\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
q=c['requests'][0]
check('te chunked', (c['error'],q['framing'],q['body'],q['trailers']), (None,'chunked',fp(b'abc'),fp(field_block([]))))
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b' CHUNKED ')]) + b'0\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('te chunked folded', (c['error'],c['requests'][0]['framing']), (None,'chunked'))
for te in [b'identity', b'gzip', b'chunked, gzip', b'']:
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',te)]))])
    check('te bad '+repr(te), c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked'),(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]))])
check('te twice', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked'),(b'Content-Length',b'1')])+b'1')])
check('te+cl', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'CHUNKED')]) + b'A;p q\r\n0123456789\r\n0\r\nX: y\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
q=c['requests'][0]
check('chunk hex+suffix+trailer', (c['error'],q['body'],q['trailers'],q['end']),
      (None,fp(b'0123456789'),fp(field_block([(b'X',b'y')])),
       len(request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'CHUNKED')]))+len(b'A;p q\r\n0123456789\r\n0\r\nX: y\r\n\r\n')))
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'0\r\n\r\n')])
check('chunk zero only', (c['error'],c['requests'][0]['body']), (None,fp(b'')))
for bad in [b'x\r\n0\r\n\r\n', b'g\r\n0\r\n\r\n', b' 1\r\nx\r\n0\r\n\r\n', b'1 ;\x01\r\nx\r\n0\r\n\r\n', b'1;x\r0\r\nx\r\n0\r\n\r\n']:
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+bad)])
    check('chunk bad '+repr(bad), c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'1\r\naX0\r\n\r\n')])
check('chunk bad crlf', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'3\r\nab')])
check('chunk short data', c['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'3\r\nabc\r')])
check('chunk short crlf', c['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'0\r\nT: v\r\n')])
check('chunk unfinished trailer', c['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})
for bad in [b'Host: h', b'Content-Length: 1', b'TRANSFER-ENCODING: chunked']:
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'0\r\n'+bad+b'\r\n\r\n')])
    check('trailer forbidden '+repr(bad), c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'0\r\nX: 1\r\nX: 2\r\n\r\n')])
check('trailer duplicates kept', c['requests'][0]['trailers'], fp(field_block([(b'X',b'1'),(b'X',b'2')])))

for line, ok in [(b'GET / HTTP/1.1',True),(b'GET  / HTTP/1.1',False),(b'GET /  HTTP/1.1',False),
                 (b'GET / HTTP/1.0',False),(b'GET / HTTP/2',False),(b' / HTTP/1.1',False),
                 (b'GET /HTTP/1.1',False),(b'G@T / HTTP/1.1',False),(b'GET /a b HTTP/1.1',False),
                 (b'GET /\t HTTP/1.1',False),(b'G ET / HTTP/1.1',False),(b"GETT!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~0 / HTTP/1.1",True)]:
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',line+b'\r\n\r\n')])
    check('reqline '+repr(line), c['error'], None if ok else {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

for hl, ok in [(b'Host: h',True),(b'Host:h',True),(b'Host : h',False),(b'Host',False),
               (b':v',False),(b'H@: v',False),(b'H: \x01',False),(b'H: \x7f',False),(b'H: \x80',False),
               (b'H: ok\tok',True),(b'H:',True),(b'H:  ',True),(b'\x00: v',False),
               (b'H: v\rmore',False),(b"X-Y_.$#%&'*+-.^_`|~0123456789: v",True)]:
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'+hl+b'\r\n\r\n')])
    check('hdr '+repr(hl), c['error'], None if ok else {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Host',b'a'),(b'HOST',b'b')]))])
check('multiple host', (c['requests'][0]['host_count'],c['requests'][0]['host'],c['requests'][0]['flags']),
      (2,fp(b''),['identity','multiple_host']))
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Host',b'A')]))])
check('one host', (c['requests'][0]['host'],c['requests'][0]['host_count']), (fp(b'a'),1))

# line limits
check('line 8192 ok', rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8178+b' HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n')])[0]['error'], None)
check('line 8193 syntax', rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8179+b' HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
check('line 8193 unfinished', rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8178+b' HTTP/1.1\r')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})
check('line long no lf syntax', rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8200+b' HTTP/1.1')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
check('header line 8192 ok', rec('e',[('a', b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nH:'+b'v'*8189+b'\r\n\r\n')])[0]['error'], None)
check('header line 8193 syntax', rec('e',[('a', b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nH:'+b'v'*8190+b'\r\n\r\n')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
check('header line 8193 unfinished', rec('e',[('a', b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nH:'+b'v'*8189+b'\r')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})
check('bare lf', rec('e',[('a', b'GET /\nHTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
check('bare lf first', rec('e',[('a', b'\r\n\r\n')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# block limits
block = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n' + b''.join(b'H:'+b'v'*498+b'\r\n' for _ in range(127)) + b'H:'+b'v'*1760+b'\r\n'
check('block exact 65536', (len(block)+2, rec('e',[('a',block+b'\r\n')])[0]['error']), (65536, None))
half = len(block)//2
check('block 65537', rec('e',[('a',block[:-2][:half]),('a',block[:-2][half:]+b'v\r\n'+b'\r\n')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
check('block 65536 split ok', rec('e',[('a',block[:half]),('a',block[half:]+b'\r\n')])[0]['error'], None)
hdrs128 = b''.join(b'X%d:v\r\n'%i for i in range(128))
check('128 fields ok', rec('e',[('a',b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'+hdrs128+b'\r\n')])[0]['error'], None)
check('129 fields syntax', rec('e',[('a',b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'+hdrs128+b'X:v\r\n\r\n')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
tr = b''.join(b'X%d:v\r\n'%i for i in range(128))
check('128 trailer fields ok', rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'0\r\n'+tr+b'\r\n')])[0]['error'], None)
check('129 trailer fields', rec('e',[('a',request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'0\r\n'+tr+b'X:v\r\n\r\n')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# boundaries between requests
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request()+request())])
check('two requests', (c['error'],c['committed'],len(c['requests'])), (None,[2],2))
check('second start', (c['requests'][1]['start'],c['requests'][1]['end']), (len(request()),2*len(request())))
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request()+b'GET /')])
check('trailing incomplete', (c['error'],len(c['requests'])), ({'kind':'incomplete','offset':len(request())},1))
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request()+b'GET /\rX')])
check('trailing unfinished prefix', c['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':len(request())})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request()+b'GET /\r\nX')])
check('trailing bad request line', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':len(request())})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',b'')])
check('empty channel', (c['error'],c['committed'],c['bytes']), (None,[0],fp(b'')))
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',''),('a','')])
check('zero parts', (c['error'],c['committed']), (None,[0,0]))
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',request()),('a','')])
check('zero part after request', (c['error'],c['committed']), (None,[1,1]))
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',''),('a',request())])
check('zero part before request', (c['error'],c['committed']), (None,[0,1]))
p1 = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n'
p2 = b'Content-Length: 3\r\n\r\n'
p3 = b'abc'
p4 = request()
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',p1),('a',p2),('a',p3),('a',p4)])
check('committed split', c['committed'], [0,0,1,2])
check('owners span', c['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',len(p1)+len(p2)+len(p3)]])
check('owners split', c['requests'][1]['owners'], [['a',len(p4)]])
check('end offset', c['requests'][0]['end'], len(p1)+len(p2)+len(p3))

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
